description: This file declares the interface IControllerFactory for creating IPC controller objects within the firebolt::rialto::ipc namespace. It includes a factory method to create instances and a method to create a protobuf RpcController, serving as a factory interface for IPC controllers.

classes.name: IControllerFactory
classes.description: An interface for creating IPC controller objects, providing a static factory method and a virtual method to create RpcController instances.

methods.name: createFactory
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to an IControllerFactory instance.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a google::protobuf::RpcController object.
